value.title: Export a pod and save a role as a template (workstream 010 s03)
value.summary: `pij pod export <pod> --as-template <path>` writes a running or closed pod, with any seat added while it ran, as a template at a path; a role can be saved as a role template with named parameters; the view suggests saving one when the same role or group is made a second time.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: `pij pod export <pod> --as-template <path>` writes a running or closed pod, with any seat added while it ran, as a template at a path; a role can be saved as a role template with named parameters; the view suggests saving one when the same role or group is made a second time.

sections.name: goals
value: A repo grows its own templates from what it actually ran.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Sharing a template back into pij (by pull request, PRD 010 q-01).

value.claim: `pij pod export <pod> --as-template <path> --why <text>` writes the pod's slots (including seats added while it ran), parameters, consulted roles and deliverables as a template at the path, in one commit when the path is in governance and as files otherwise.
`pij directory export <role> --as-template <path>` saves a role with its parameters as a role template.
The view suggests saving a template when a role or a group of roles of the same shape is created a second time, with the export command.

value.title: Export a pod and save a role as a template (workstream 010 s03)

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Pod folders and templates (plans 247, 254); role parameters (plan 240); the view's prompts (community/picture.rs).

value.risk: An exported template names a seat-specific value.
value.mitigation: Export writes parameters, never seat ids or paths.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: one write per export; the view's suggestion is computed when the view is asked. No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
